name: SkyLab
description: Inspect Skyrim meshes, textures, and NPC appearances in an in-game 3D editor.

settings.label: Open SkyLab
settings.description: Open the SkyLab module in SkyViewer and toggle its in-game editor.

settings.label: Open the crosshair target on toggle
settings.description: When SkyLab opens, automatically load the NIF of the object under the crosshair.

settings.label: Show collision by default
settings.description: Show available collision information and preview geometry.

settings.label: Start in wireframe mode
settings.description: Draw preview meshes in wireframe when the editor opens.

settings.label: Show vertex normals
settings.description: Display normal vectors in the 3D preview.

settings.label: Show UV overlay
settings.description: Display UV coordinates in the 3D preview.

settings.label: Preview field of view
settings.description: Adjust the 3D preview camera field of view.
